column7: transferOwnership checked "already owned by that user" and GetUser(newOwnerID) before it authorized the actor, so a caller with no right to the secret could tell from the refusal whether a user ID exists and who owns the secret. The actor is now authorized first; an unauthorized actor gets the same sentinel and text for every newOwnerID (REST: TestTransferOwnership_UnauthorizedActorIdenticalRefusalOverREST). Found in the #3794 review (OWNERSHIP-ORACLE-1)
